newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Unocal says Attaka crude field restarted.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says Attaka crude field restarted.

text.p: Production at the Attaka crude oil field near Balikpapan in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province was restarted on Tuesday after an oil rig fire on Sunday, an official with operator Unocal Indonesia said.
The company is a subsidiary of Unocal corp.
Ignatia, crude lifting coordinator at Unocal Indonesia, told Reuters that Attaka was now operating at about half its full capacity while the nearby Santan field would be restarted later on Tuesday.
Both fields were shut down on Sunday after a fire broke out on the Attaka Echo Platform offshore rig. There were no casualties, Indonesian state oil company Pertamina said.
Attaka produced 72,810 barrels per day of crude in July. Ignatia said losses from the fire were still to be estimated.
The Jakarta Post newspaper estimated losses from the fire at between 18 billion rupiah and 42 billion rupiah.
